rulings.reason: The contract says unconditionally that the state becomes true at an entry, and the record discloses the reading that the distance is not tested at the entry observation. That is a choice among the meanings the contract's words allow. The divergence also arises only because the caller set clearance to zero, so it turns on the size of a parameter the caller sets.
rulings.quote: It becomes true at an entry, holds while x stays on r or within clearance of it
